clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker sends dwarf paladins back to Ironforge. There, Tiza Battleforge guides them toward the sacred trials of the Tome of Divinity.

Dwarf paladins often aid Stormwind and travel through human lands, but their spiritual and martial roots lie in Khaz Modan. When Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker judges that a dwarf has gained enough field training, he sends them to Ironforge. Their own people there guide the spiritual duties expected of a full Knight of the Silver Hand.

In Ironforge, you are directed to the Mystic Ward and the Hall of Mysteries. Tiza Battleforge waits on its upper level, where she mentors young dwarven paladins. She prepares them to bear the burden of the Holy Light through sacred trials recorded in the Tome of Divinity.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hello, friend. I know you're busy helping out the people of Azeroth, but when you have the time, you should return to Ironforge and speak to one of the most respected paladins of your home: Tiza Battleforge. She's the one the younger dwarven paladins go to when it is time they learn more about the Light and what's expected of all of us.
You can find her upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries which is located in the Mystic Ward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I greet you, and bid you welcome, friend.
